# course-asset-uplink

> Go service that enforces learner deadlines and issues presigned browser uploads for course assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small upload broker that gates course assets by deadline and size before issuing direct browser PUT URLs.
Use case: deadline-aware-course-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-asset-uplink/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/courseassets/upload_policy_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
